name: Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector
briefDescription: The scheme offers financial incentives (capital subsidy, interest subvention, and electricity duty reimbursement) to private/NGO entities establishing new super specialty hospitals (50+ beds) in Gujarat, targeting underserved areas.
descriptionMd: Launched on 13th December 2016, the "Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector" by the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to address the shortage of high-end medical facilities in remote areas by incentivizing private and non-governmental organizations to establish super specialty hospitals. The scheme provides 10% capital subsidy on medical equipment loans (up to ₹10 crore), 4% interest subvention (max ₹40 crore loan) for 7 years, and reimbursement of electricity duty for 5 years. Eligible entities include registered doctors, firms, trusts, and corporations.
benefitsMd: > **Capital Subsidy** - 10% of bank loans for medical equipment (max ₹10 crore). - Disbursed post-hospital operationalization. > **Interest Subvention** - 4% interest relief on loans up to ₹40 crore for 7 years. - Paid in 6 annual installments after a 1-year grace period. > **Electricity Duty Reimbursement** 100% reimbursement for 5 years (quarterly claims). > **Employment Generation** Mandates hiring qualified medical/paramedical staff. > **Disbursement** - **Capital Subsidy:** After Equipment Installation and Hospital Launch.- **Interest Subvention:** Annual Installments Post 1-Year Grace Period.- **Electricity Reimbursement:** Quarterly Claims.
eligibilityMd: > **The Following Entities Are Eligible** - Registered Doctors (Gujarat Medical Council). - Partnership Firms, Companies, Trusts, Societies, Cooperatives. > **Hospital Requirements** - 50+ Total Beds,including 10+ Super Specialty Beds. - Covers Specialties Like Cardiology, Neurology, Oncology, etc. (List Expandable by Government). > **Loan Conditions** - Only Loans for Construction/Equipment (Excludes Land/Working Capital).
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://gujhealth.gujarat.gov.in/images/pdf/Application-forms-for-Establishment-of-New-Super-Specialty-Hospital-new.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to - ***Commissioner, Health & Medical Education, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, Gandhinagar***. Pay ₹20,000/- scrutiny fee via Demand Draft. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date of submission.
**Approval & Verification** - State-Level Committee scrutinizes applications. - Technical Group conducts physical inspections. **Compliance** - Submit quarterly utilization reports. - Maintain services for 7 years (penalty: repayment if violated).
